body:
Insists that she hears her lost mother calling from the mist.

Recorded role and choices

Thera offers to guide the adults toward the missing supplies and then insists the mist contains the voice of her mother. Her father tries to restrain and correct her; she reacts angrily and runs off around the tavern. This is an encounter shaped by grief and a reported perception. It does not confirm a resurrection or resolve the cause of the mist.
